clues.text: In the wilderness, God gave Israel bread for two days on the sixth day so they could rest on this one.
In His commandments, God blessed this day and made it holy, because He rested after making the heavens and earth.
While Israel was in the wilderness, a man was found gathering wood on this day.
Nehemiah had Jerusalem's gates shut at evening so merchants could not bring their loads in on this day.
On this day, the disciples of Jesus began to pick heads of grain as they passed through the grainfields.
A synagogue leader was indignant when Jesus healed on this day, telling the crowd there are six days for work.
When this day was over, Mary Magdalene and Salome bought spices to anoint the body of Jesus.
